title: Topic 17
japanese_text:
A：学生時代は真面目だった？
B：全く！<u>年配</u>の厳しい先生と言い合いになって、教室の窓ガラス割ったことあるよ。バイトして弁償はしたけど、<u>意地</u>になって、卒業まで謝らなかったな。
A：えー、ほんとに？
B：本当だよ。ほらここ、ガラスの<u>破片</u>で切った<u>痕</u>。
english_translation: A: When you were school, did you take it seriously? B: Not at all! I once got into an argument with an elderly teacher who was very strict, and broke a classroom window. I worked part-time to pay for it, but I was too proud to apologize until graduation. A: Oh, really? B: It’s true. Look, here’s a scar from a fragment of glass.
